title: Highway Traffic Act, R.S.O. 1990, c. H.8
how: Word file: direct download. *.rendered.html: the e-Laws page rendered with headless Chrome (--dump-dom) so the currency date and body are present. *.txt: plain text made from the rendered page, one block element per line. hta.html: the page as first fetched with curl (no JavaScript; same body text).
